instruction: Now your standing in the kitchen turn backward and move forward towards the refrigerator turn left and move forward behind the table, Turn right move little bit forward then again move backward and move forward towards the dinning table move forward towards the wash-basin and a mirror. Turn slightly left and move forward where there is an open path go straight in the opposite you will find a open door enter into the room, Where the room is with an open space stand in the middle of the room that will be your final destination.
